response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience as a Staff Software Engineer with recent involvement in AI-agent infrastructure (MCP, agentic workflows) and TypeScript/Python-proficient roles, aligning with key GenAI and cloud requirements. However, his resume lacks explicit mention of production-grade AI solution building, vector databases, RAG architectures, or multi-agent frameworks. His experience is more generalist (full-stack, embedded, GIS) with limited direct GenAI cloud delivery to enterprise customers.
strengths: Staff-level engineering experience with full-stack and AI-agent infrastructure (MCP, agentic workflows)
Proficient in TypeScript and Node.js, with recent work in Python (re:cinq)
Strong background in cloud-native development (AWS CDK, Kubernetes) and scalability (millions of requests/sec)
concerns: No clear evidence of 8+ years building production-grade AI solutions or vector databases/RAG architectures
Limited direct experience with major cloud platforms in AI systems (AWS/GCP/Azure) — mostly used for DevOps/tooling
No mention of LLM performance metrics, optimization techniques, or multi-agent system frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI)

key_factors.factor: Cloud platform experience for AI systems
Leadership in AI delivery to enterprise customers
